facts.text: The resort is a two-minute walk from Punda Beach.
facts.excerpt: Just a two-minute walk from Punda Beach, with its soft sand and crystal-clear waters, the resort invites guests to embrace the essence of summer.

facts.text: The resort is located near the seaside village of Piso Livadi.
facts.excerpt: Summer Senses is located near the authentic seaside village of Piso Livadi, a place known for its traditional character, relaxed rhythm, and waterfront tavernas shaped by everyday island life.

facts.text: The resort is on the eastern edge of Paros with Aegean Sea views.
facts.excerpt: Summer Senses Luxury Resort is located on the eastern edge of the island and boasts beautiful Aegean Sea views.

facts.text: Punda Beach has crystal clear, deep blue waters and two beach bars.
facts.excerpt: Known for its crystal clear, deep blue waters, it’s a favourite in Paros; modern, cosmopolitan vibes and refreshing cocktails take centre stage at its two beach bars

facts.text: The hotel has two swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: Dive into the refreshing waters of the hotel’s two swimming pools

facts.text: Spa therapies are offered at the Anassa Spa by Idolo.
facts.excerpt: a revitalising spa therapy at the Anassa Spa by Idolo

facts.text: Galazia Hytra offers fine dining under the stars.
facts.excerpt: Take a seat at the best luxury restaurant in Paros, indulging in an evening of fine dining under the Mediterranean stars.

facts.text: Gaia Restaurant serves an authentic Greek breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Start your day the right way, with authentic Greek breakfast at the inviting Gaia Restaurant, while enjoying the mesmerising vistas.

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have an elegantly minimal Cycladic style and open to a private outdoor space.
facts.excerpt: Our Deluxe Rooms (approx. 25 sqm) are Cycladic havens with elegantly minimal style, which open to a private outdoor space

facts.text: Several suite types have an outdoor private pool, including Summer Suites and Senses Suites with sea views over the Aegean coastline.
facts.excerpt:
- View: Superb views of the Aegean over the island’s coastline
- Outdoor private pool

facts.text: The Honeymoon Suite has a private pool, sea view and an outdoor heated jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: The majestic Honeymoon Suite with Private Pool, Sea View & outdoor heated Jacuzzi

facts.text: Premium Suites feature Parian marble flooring.
facts.excerpt: A sense of luxury surrounds our Premium Suites (approx. 42 sqm), from the exquisite Parian marble used in their flooring

facts.text: Sea-view Sun Suites and Island Suites have views of the Aegean and sunrise vistas.
facts.excerpt: - View: Uninterrupted views of the Aegean blue and spectacular sunrise vistas

facts.text: Guests can go kitesurfing on Punda Beach.
facts.excerpt: an afternoon of kitesurfing on Punda Beach

facts.text: A seaside hiking path connects Punda Beach with Piso Livadi and Logaras over a 3 km route.
facts.excerpt: Follow the path which connects Punda Beach with Piso Livadi and Logaras to savour a 3km route by the sea, with refreshing breaks to take dips in crystal-clear waters.

facts.text: The resort is 19 km from Paroikia Port and 12 km from Naoussa town.
facts.excerpt:
Paroikia Port 19 km

Paros Airport 18.7 km

Naoussa Town 12 km

facts.text: The village of Marpissa is a stone's throw from the resort.
facts.excerpt: A stone’s throw from Summer Senses Luxury Resort, Marpissa is a gorgeous village built amphitheatrically on the crest of a small hill.

facts.text: The resort presents itself as a choice for couples and families.
facts.excerpt: the perfect choice for couples and families looking for a relaxing island getaway
